THIS ENDORSEMENT CHANGES THE POLICY.  PLEASE READ IT CAREFULLY.
This endorsement modifies insurance provided under the following:
Any individual named in the SCHEDULE below is designated as a Named Insured in addition to the first Named Insured shown in Item One of the Declarations.
The words "you" and "your" include any individual designated in the SCHEDULE and his or her spouse resident in the same household; except,
The first Named Insured is only the farm family partnership or farm family corporation named in Item One of the Declarations.
For the individual Named Insured(s) shown in the SCHEDULE, the policy is changed as follows:
not apply to "bodily injury" to you or any "family member's " fellow employees.
While any "auto" you own is a covered "auto" under LIABILITY COVERAGE:
The following is added to WHO IS AN INSURED:
"Family members" are "insureds" for any covered "auto" you own and any other "auto" described in paragraph
Any "auto" you don't own is a covered "auto" while being used by you or by any "family member" except:
Any "auto" owned by any "family members" that is not described as a covered "auto" in Item Three of the Declarations.
Any "auto" furnished or available for your or any "family member's" regular use that is neither described in Item Three of the Declarations nor owned by any other Named Insured on this policy.
Any "auto" used by you or by any of your "family members" while working in a business of selling, servicing, repairing or parking "autos."
Any "auto" other than a "private passenger type" "auto" used by you or any of your "family members" while working in any other business or occupation.
The POLLUTION Exclusion and, if forming a part of the policy, the NUCLEAR ENERGY LIABILITY EXCLUSION (BROAD FORM),
does not apply to any covered "auto" of the "private passenger type."
The following exclusion is added and applies only to "private passenger type" covered "autos":
This insurance does not apply to:

"Bodily injury" or "property damage" for which an "insured" under the policy is also an "insured" under the nuclear energy liability policy or would be an "insured" but for its termination upon its exhaustion of its limit of liability. A nuclear energy liability policy is a policy issued by Nuclear Energy Liability Insurance Association, Mutual Atomic Energy Liability Underwriters or any of their successors. This exclusion does not apply to "autos" registered or principally garaged in New York.
While any "auto" you own is a covered "auto" under PHYSICAL DAMAGE COVERAGE , a "non-owned
auto" will also be considered a covered "auto." However, the most we will pay for "loss" to a "non- owned auto" that is a "trailer" is $500.
The following is added to the DEFINITIONS Section:
"Family member" means a person related to you by blood, marriage or adoption who is a resident of your household, including a ward or foster child.
The words "you" and "your" include your spouse if a resident of the same household.

When the phrase "private passenger type auto" appears in quotation marks it includes any covered "auto" you own of the pick-up or van type not used for business purposes, other than farming or ranching.

When the phrase "non-owned auto" appears in quotation marks it means any "private passenger type auto" not owned by you or any "family member" while it is in the custody of or while it is being operated by you or any "family member."
